import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import warnings
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline, FeatureUnion
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train data shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test data shape: {test_df.shape}")

np.random.seed(42)
train_split, val_split = train_test_split(
    train_df, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=train_df["author"]
)

le = LabelEncoder()
train_split["author_encoded"] = le.fit_transform(train_split["author"])
val_split["author_encoded"] = le.transform(val_split["author"])

classes = le.classes_
class_labels = list(classes)
print(f"Classes: {class_labels}")

# Word n-grams with stop_words removal (same as previous solution)
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    max_features=200000,
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.9,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    norm="l2",
    analyzer="word",
    stop_words="english",
)

# Character n-grams with extended range (1-7) (NEW)
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 7),
    max_features=200000,
    min_df=1,
    max_df=0.9,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    norm="l2",
    analyzer="char",
)

pipe = Pipeline(
    [
        (
            "features",
            FeatureUnion(
                transformer_list=[
                    ("word", word_vectorizer),
                    ("char", char_vectorizer),
                ]
            ),
        ),
        (
            "clf",
            LogisticRegression(
                max_iter=500,
                solver="lbfgs",
                multi_class="multinomial",
                C=10.0,
                class_weight="balanced",
            ),
        ),
    ]
)

pipe.fit(train_split["text"], train_split["author_encoded"])

val_predictions = pipe.predict(val_split["text"])
val_probs = pipe.predict_proba(val_split["text"])

validation_log_loss = log_loss(val_split["author_encoded"], val_probs)

print(f"Validation Log Loss: {validation_log_loss:.6f}")

test_predictions = pipe.predict_proba(test_df["text"])

submission = pd.DataFrame()
submission["id"] = test_df["id"]
submission["EAP"] = test_predictions[:, 0]
submission["HPL"] = test_predictions[:, 1]
submission["MWS"] = test_predictions[:, 2]

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved with {len(submission)} rows")
print(f"Submission saved to: ./submission/submission.csv")

print(f"\nFinal validation log loss: {validation_log_loss:.6f}")
